Software Developer | Poet & Writer | Student of Islamic Sciences

Muhammad Talha Bin Fareed is a software developer, poet, writer and student of the Islamic sciences from Pakistan. His main fields of interest are technology, Islamic sciences, fiqh research, Urdu literature and digital publishing.

He wants modern technology to be an effective means of advancing knowledge and research, providing educational facilities and promoting scholarly and literary heritage. His practical efforts show a clear attempt to build a purposeful connection between scholarly tradition and modern digital possibilities.

Muhammad Talha Bin Fareed is a student of al-Shahadat al-Alamiyya (second year), the final stage of the Dars-e-Nizami. His scholarly affiliation is with Hanafi fiqh, while he also has a special scholarly and research interest in Maliki fiqh.

He is particularly engaged in the study, research and translation from Arabic into Urdu of the foundational texts of Maliki fiqh, their commentaries, fiqh details and the views of the Maliki imams and jurists.

An important aim of his scholarly efforts is to understand the scholarly heritage of the schools of fiqh in the light of original and authoritative sources, to study their reasoning and fiqh methodologies, and to present what he learns in a way ordinary Urdu readers can understand.

In the study of fiqh differences, he gives fundamental importance to scholarly honesty, research, evidence and breadth of vision.

Poetry and writing are prominent aspects of his personality. He has a deep attachment to the Urdu language and literature, and expresses himself on intellectual, philosophical, literary and creative subjects.

In the literary world he is known as Muhammad Talha Gohar. His pen name is Talha Gohar and his poetic takhallus is Gohar.

His poetry is marked by the expression of thought and feeling, life's experiences, human emotions and inner intellectual and spiritual states. For him, literature is not merely the beautiful arrangement of words, but the preservation of human consciousness, feeling and experience through the art of expression.

Software development is an important field among his practical interests and creative activities. He works on the planning, building and development of various mobile applications, web platforms and digital projects.

His special focus is on applications of an educational, Islamic, research and informational nature, whose aim is to make knowledge easier to access, provide effective digital facilities for everyday needs, and put modern technology to purposeful use.

For him, software is not merely a collection of code, design and technical features, but a means of practically solving problems and fulfilling human needs. Guided by this idea, he tries to create products that combine usefulness, simplicity and quality.
Malikimadhab.org — A Maliki Fiqh Research Platform

Malikimadhab.org is one of his important scholarly and research projects, whose basic aim is to introduce the authoritative scholarly heritage of Maliki fiqh in Urdu and to make it easier to access.

This platform is a scholarly effort to bring the foundational sources of Maliki fiqh, its fiqh texts, commentaries, scholarly discussions and research material to Urdu readers, so that effective scholarly resources for the study and understanding of Maliki fiqh can be provided to Urdu-reading circles in the Subcontinent.

This project focuses in particular on the following scholarly and research activities:
• Introducing and studying the foundational sources and authoritative books of Maliki fiqh.
• Translating Arabic fiqh texts and commentaries into Urdu.
• Researching and explaining fiqh issues, details and scholarly views.
• Publishing research articles and scholarly material on Maliki fiqh.
• Making the Maliki fiqh heritage accessible through digital technology.

Through this project, his effort is that the introduction to Maliki fiqh should not remain limited to brief information, but that readers should also have opportunities to benefit directly from its original scholarly sources and fiqh tradition.

The central axis of Muhammad Talha Bin Fareed's intellectual and practical journey is the combination of knowledge, research, creativity and technology. He believes that modern digital means should be used for the preservation of scholarly and civilizational heritage, the promotion of research, quality education and positive social change.

His goal is not merely to build modern applications and digital products, but to present useful efforts that play their part in spreading knowledge, serving the Urdu language, protecting scholarly heritage and fulfilling society's real needs.

He sees his scholarly position as that of a student and a learner. For him, knowledge is a continuous journey in which research, questioning, study, critical thought and scholarly honesty are fundamentally important.
The pursuit of knowledge, the flight of thought, the creation of the pen, and the use of technology — one purposeful journey.

The console publishes catalog.json to the TalhaGoharWeb/talha-gohar-apps repo on GitHub. Create a token at GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic), with the repo scope (or a fine-grained token with Contents read/write on this repo). The token stays only on this phone and can be revoked anytime from GitHub.
